consumption.title: Consumption leaderboard
consumption.description: Compare token usage and costs by channel, key group, model, API key, or user.
consumption.usageDescription: View request counts, token usage, and costs by key group, model, API key, or user in the current project.
consumption.projectLoadError: Project options could not be loaded. All-project statistics remain available.
consumption.modelCostNote: Grouped by the final upstream model, using the requested model when no execution was recorded. Costs use historical records. Missing metrics display an em dash.
consumption.modelCacheNote: Grouped by the final upstream model, using the requested model when no execution was recorded. Includes only cache-active requests and their full historical costs.
consumption.cacheRequestsHelp: Requests that reported cache reads or writes.
consumption.cacheHitRateHelp: Cache read tokens divided by total input tokens of requests with cache reads or writes. Requests without cache activity are excluded.
consumption.cacheCoefficientHelp: Observed cache reads divided by estimated cacheable tokens, adjusted by the eligible-sample ratio and sample count to a 0–1 score. Compares cache utilization, not price discounts. Fewer than 5 / 30 / 100 eligible samples apply factors of 0.1 / 0.3 / 0.6; at least 100 apply 1. Updates lag by about 15–20 minutes.
consumption.cacheCoefficientNote: The cache coefficient compares observed cache utilization across channels. Closer to 1 is better; it is neither a billing discount nor the cache hit rate, and small samples lower the score.
consumption.avgCostPerMillionTokensHelp: Cost of fully priced requests with input/output tokens × 1,000,000 ÷ input and output tokens from those same requests. Per-request fees with no tokens are excluded; no eligible samples displays —.
consumption.channelSuccessRateHelp: Successful attempts on this channel divided by its successful and failed attempts. Failover success does not erase earlier failures. Upstream 400, 404 and 429 responses count as failures; undispatched local rejections and client cancellations are excluded.
consumption.successRateHelp: Successful requests divided by countable outcomes. Follows CCH exclusions for client aborts after response data, 404s, quota and rate limits.
consumption.firstTokenHelp: Average time from the actual channel attempt start to its first text, reasoning content or tool arguments. Status frames and missing timings are excluded.
consumption.speedHelp: Each rate is output tokens divided by execution duration minus upstream first-byte wait. Averages use valid speed sample counts. Missing timing, unmatched usage and windows under 100 ms are excluded.
consumption.empty: No data in the selected time range
consumption.cacheNote: Only requests with cache reads or writes are included. Cost is the full historical cost of those requests. Cache coefficients lag by about 15–20 minutes.
consumption.totalCostHelp: Full historical cost of requests with cache activity in the selected scope, including input and output charges, not just cache charges.
consumption.costNote: Requests use final attribution; cost includes all saved usage, including retries and parallel backups. Unavailable metrics appear as “—”.
consumption.channelCostNote: Request counts use final attribution; costs belong to the channel that incurred them. A retry channel may have cost and zero final requests. Success rates count actual attempts.
consumption.overallCacheHitRateHelp: Cache-read tokens divided by input tokens from all requests, including cache misses. Shown as — when there are no input tokens.
